cards.review_notes: Confirm the year and location with the church. Official registration form search results state July 6–10 without a year; 2026 comes from https://allevents.in/lowland/point-pleasant-baptist-church-vbs/200030095404545. Address is supported by that listing and the SBC church directory, rather than a readable church-published address. The third-party event starts at 5:30 p.m.; the official form distinguishes the 5:30 meal from VBS at 6:30–8:30. The form asks for sensory issues and ways to support children but does not state an accommodation policy. Its bus-route question concerns Sunday School/Kids Church, not VBS transportation.
